clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Durotar, Margoz watches for the Burning Blade's growing threat. After the clash with fel corruption at Thunder Ridge, Orgnil Soulscar sends champions to seek the isolated orc shaman before they strike a nearby cultist stronghold. Margoz's counsel reveals Skull Rock, the Burning Blade's concealed cavern base.

After Thunder Ridge revealed the depth of fel taint, Orgnil Soulscar sees that strength alone cannot cleanse Durotar. He sends champions to Margoz, an experienced orc shaman keeping a lonely camp in the crags northeast of Razor Hill. Between Drygulch Ravine and the eastern sea, Margoz watches the northern reaches for dark omens that Orgrimmar's busy warriors often miss.

Margoz knows the Burning Blade's power base in northern Durotar: Skull Rock, a concealed cavern system carved into the mountain cliffs outside Orgrimmar's southern gates. The cultists are closer to Thrall's capital than the Warchief's guards realize, and Skull Rock's hidden passages can conceal a demonic ambush. Margoz gives those sent against the coven counsel so they do not enter blindly.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of our Shamans, Margoz, knows more of the Burning Blade's corruption. He speaks of a cave called Skull Rock in the mountains - just outside Orgrimmar! - that shelters a large band of Burning Blade cultists.
Before you go to Skull Rock speak with Margoz. He is wise and his council is valued.
He is camped to the northeast, between the coast and Drygulch Ravine.
Follow his advice, but whatever Margoz says, friend, I still want you to crush those cultists!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome, friend. Word reached me of your coming, and of your exploits in Durotar.
You are an adventurer of growing skill and renown.
Stay on the pure path, and your future will be great indeed.
